general.avisos_via_ayuda_intro: VEC performs these checks using recruitment pool data and catalogue rules. They are proposals only: HR decides the recruitment route in the form below, as before.
general.avisos_via_ayuda_sin_reglas: No rules have been applied because there are no notices.
general.avisos_via_ninguno: No notices: the recruitment pool has available people and remains valid.
general.avisos_via_sin_bolsa: No recruitment pool has been established for this category.
general.avisos_via_no_disponible: Recruitment pool checks are currently unavailable; no result is shown.
general.avisos_via_bolsa_agotada_provisionalment: {disponibles} people available out of {integrantes} (the pool is deemed exhausted when {umbral} or fewer remain). Final exhaustion requires an express decision.
general.avisos_via_propuesta_oferta_sae_titulo: Vacancy submission to the Andalusian Employment Service
general.avisos_via_propuesta_oferta_sae_detalle: Maximum duration of {meses} months: the appointment could not extend beyond {fin_maximo}.
general.avisos_via_propuesta_oferta_sae_excede: The expected end date in the analysis ({fin_previsto}) exceeds that maximum duration.
general.avisos_via_propuesta_oferta_sae_sin_fin: No end date is planned. The maximum duration will apply when an end date is set.
general.avisos_via_nueva_convocatoria_titulo: New call for applications to the recruitment pool
general.avisos_via_motivo_vigencia_superada: The recruitment pool expired on {vigencia_hasta} (established on {constituida_en}).
